description: The two-mode comparison table (§2) states, in the SELF-FUNDED column, 'Claude NOT available (needs a human sub)' (line 67). REQ-MODEL, describing the model-change for that SAME self-funded default (line 76-78), states: 'frontier pins (`anthropic/claude-opus-4.8`, `xai/grok-4`) still allowed.' These directly conflict inside the same document: one line says a self-funded instance cannot use Claude/Opus at all (needs a human subscription), the next says pinning to claude-opus-4.8 is an allowed frontier choice for that identical self-funded default model. No distinction (e.g. 'Claude via wallet-paid ClawRouter API' vs 'Claude via a human's subscription login') is drawn anywhere to reconcile this.

evidence.snippet: | Model | ... Claude NOT available (needs a human sub). | Claude (Sonnet ceiling, Opus forbidden) | ... REQ-MODEL: ... frontier pins (`anthropic/claude-opus-4.8`, `xai/grok-4`) still allowed.
